description: Defines the Article domain model class for the application, including properties for article details, relationships, and computed attributes.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents a blog article with properties for content, author, comments, and tags.

methods.name: Favorited
methods.description: Indicates whether the article has been favorited by any user.

methods.name: FavoritesCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of favorites for the article.

methods.name: TagList
methods.description: Provides a list of tags associated with the article.
